seed_contamination_check.rule: If any seed in the block was used in prior exploratory artifacts, replace the whole block with the next untouched consecutive block.
seed_contamination_check.result_at_registration: No exact seed field for 426 through 435 was found in existing repository results; the declared block is retained.

methods.hand: The original hand-designed three-observable fiber, with no optimization.
methods.full_grad: The frozen Stage-4 optimizer initialized at hand and differentiated through the complete fiber construction, including the converged I-projection custom JVP and time-derivative solve.
methods.stop_grad: The same forward construction and optimizer protocol as full_grad, with only the backward derivative ablated as specified in stop_gradient_definition.

primary_estimand.name: delta_full_minus_hand
primary_estimand.success_rule: upper endpoint of the paired two-sided 95% Student-t confidence interval is less than zero

mechanistic_estimand.name: delta_full_minus_stop
mechanistic_estimand.success_rule: upper endpoint of the paired two-sided 95% Student-t confidence interval is less than zero

selection_rule: For each optimized method independently, choose the minimum selection-bank construction objective among checkpoints 0,5,...,40. Checkpoint 0 is the exact hand fiber. Evaluation-bank metrics and q4 are unavailable to selection.

frozen_objective.E_corr: trapezoidal integral of weighted Ritz correction energy over construction times
frozen_objective.P_forcing: trapezoidal integral of weighted forcing power over construction times
frozen_objective.P_ESS: 15 * trapezoidal integral of relu(0.18 - ESS)^2 over construction times

frozen_config.candidate_dictionary: 11 radial pair-distance RBFs: the three hand centers followed by the fixed eight Ritz centers; no q4 or angular descriptor
frozen_config.fiber_parameterization: rank-three Euclidean row-orthonormal coefficients in the endpoint-gap nullspace, initialized at the exact hand subspace
frozen_config.reference_schedule: per-seed optimized_multi schedule selected by the established standard-mode Level-2 schedule prefix

stop_gradient_definition.forward_semantics: Bit-for-bit the same operations as full_grad at identical fiber parameters.
backward_semantics: Apply stop_gradient to the converged I-projection multiplier lambda_star.
Apply stop_gradient to the projected weights, calibrated moments, and calibrated covariance.
Apply stop_gradient to the weighted expected observable time derivative and covariance time-derivative term.
Apply stop_gradient to the solved multiplier time derivative lambda_dot.

Retain direct derivatives of observables, observable Jacobians/time derivatives, forcing, Ritz coefficients, correction energy, forcing power, and the objective while treating the stopped calibrated quantities as constants.

numerical_checks_before_scientific_runs.forward_equivalence: At several deterministic candidate fibers, absolute full_grad versus stop_grad forward difference <= 1e-10.
numerical_checks_before_scientific_runs.full_gradient: One full-objective directional autodiff derivative must agree with a central finite difference comparably to the prior Stage-4 check.
numerical_checks_before_scientific_runs.gradient_ablation: Forward values agree while the full and stopped gradients have nonzero norm discrepancy.

q4_rule: q4 is strictly evaluation-only and cannot enter the dictionary, objective, optimization, or checkpoint selection.
downstream_test: Not part of the required confirmation and not run unless separately undertaken after Stage-4B analysis is frozen.
stage5_rule: Do not implement Stage 5. It is scientifically justified only if both predeclared confidence-interval criteria pass.
